component.name: DLSS Swapper
component.summary: Conveniently download, install, and swap DLSS, FSR, and XeSS versions in your games

description.p: DLSS Swapper is an open-source application that allows you to manage, update, and swap NVIDIA DLSS, AMD FSR, and Intel XeSS libraries for your installed games across Steam, Heroic Games Launcher, and custom game installations.

ul.li: Automatic detection of installed games and upscaler versions
Instant downloading and swapping of official DLSS, FSR 3.1, and XeSS DLLs
Proton/Wine prefix compatibility and per-game DLSS Developer Options
Full support for Steam, Heroic, and manually added game paths
Light and dark theme UI with multilingual localization
